behavior: 21-word request contains phase, increment, modulation, depth, gain, EG state/control/eight parameters, two feedback samples, feedback depth, noise state, waveform/mode flags, shape.
Output words: sample, next phase, EG level, EG flags, next noise state.
Independent four-stage linear EG advances once per request. Feedback reads two previous samples, not current output.
Six waveform types; 1024-point interpolated sine and two writable frames; initial tables are sine.
Single in-flight request. Output and tag stable during backpressure. Table writes only when idle and no request accepted.

DX envelope executes in parallel with wave math. State result is logarithmic, amplitude is separate. PM source normalized by8 restores phase with source<<9; feedback strength0..7 uses history_average<<(strength+1). DX sine reads old phase before increment.
DX extension: request flags word19 bit5 selects DX mode; bits12:6 note,19:13 velocity,26:20 scaled output level. Word20 carries packed key/velocity scaling.

Two physical signed33-by-signed32 multiplier lanes are shared by phase/feedback at state0, table interpolation at3, morph/AM factor at4, wave at5, amplitude at7 and final sample at8. Each destination retains the original exact product width and bit slices. No request/result latency change; native and DX result remains ten clocks.
constraints: Single 50 MHz clock domain; reset cancels in-flight work.
See ENGINE.md for exact fixed-point and command ABI.

behavior: Raw opcodes0..4 bypass to the existing fabric; non-context errors and malformed packets preserve raw fabric semantics.
Context opcodes80..84 hex bind core0..4;90 hex RUN;91 hex INSPECT. A context command waits for all raw completions and packet drain.
Metadata: context_id bits327:320 must be0..31; generation bits351:328 monotonic24; sequence bits383:352 contiguous32 starting0 after bind.
BIND caches exact320-bit initial image and initial state. Same generation/image/type replays acknowledgment without resetting state; changed same generation conflicts; older generation is rejected.
RUN runtime_a bits31:0, runtime_b bits63:32, EG event bits65:64; upper payload bits319:66 must be zero. First sequence0, then last+1; exact last sequence and signature replay cached result.
Older sequences return status6, gaps7, same sequence/different signature5, missing/bad ID3, stale generation4, reserved payload8. Error has no state effects.
PM/segment/noise update current low32; MultiEG also updates stage bits34:32; MAC is stateless and uses live a/b with resident gains.
Response low64 core result, bits71:64 status, bit72 replay. INSPECT returns state bits34:0, history valid73, core78:76,last sequence111:80.
Output remains stable under backpressure. State commits once when the checked core completion is accepted, before response consumption.
Only last execution retained per context. Context generation and history are volatile; reset invalidates all contexts and cancels outstanding tasks.
constraints: Candidate only; no board integration. Single clock, external synchronized reset release.
This is an operator context table, not a voice allocator, autonomous sample scheduler or complete FM operator.
Generation/sequence must not wrap within a context session. Caller must establish a fresh transport session after reset.
Same AXI ID or note number is not a deduplication key. New sequence means a new legitimate calculation.

behavior: 24 state slots: eight patch-global and sixteen voice-local. Only enabled/eligible source contexts advance, once per frame; routes never advance source state.

behavior: Four patch slots, two atomic parameter banks each; six topologically ordered operators per patch.
Eight dynamic voices, independent phase/EG/noise/feedback state; a single physical composite operator is scheduled for each enabled logical operator.
Control sequence/epoch protects retries; note identity protects held-key duplicate events; note release never targets a replacement with another identity.
Commands apply between frames; completion backpressure never freezes audio rendering.
VoiceModulation advances patch-global and voice-local LFOs once per enabled audio frame, then resolves eight routes per voice; base parameters remain unchanged.
Fixed voice-capacity headroom, normalized carriers, smoothed live gain/pan and stereo output. This is a generic engine, not exact DX7 or Surge emulation.
Synchronous program RAM: state17 waits after operator advance; eight full voices add40 clocks, voice898 / full chain971 of1024.

Synchronous program and packed163-bit context RAM: state17 waits after operator advance; eight full voices add40 clocks, voice898 / full chain971 of1024. Allocation invalidates context flags; first use zeroes phase/EG/history and seeds noise=context+1; note gate events cannot bypass initialization.

A4/A6 optional word4 marker31 plus velocity[13:7]/note[6:0]. Zero defaults60/100. Duplicate identity must match metadata. Metadata stored independently per voice. Four resident slots and eight voices unchanged.
DX extension: A1 flags15 mode,22:16 scaled output; DX sine/PM only, feedback0..7, depth0, ratio<=64. A2 DX levels<=4032,L4=0,rates<=63; A1 invalidates that row EG until A2 reloads it.

A3 returns BUSY10 when any active voice uses the slot and any row changes native/DX state format; the old bank stays live and the draft remains available for a later new-sequence retry after voices finish or panic.

Note CAM is an eight-cycle snapshot search while audio FSM idle. Note commands A4/A5/A6 wait for lookup DONE before READY. A sample tick or non-idle audio cancels the lookup; restart after rendering. Exact ID last match, first free, oldest first tie remain unchanged; other commands do not wait for CAM.

Command identity and payload validation are registered before mutation. The source holds its request through READY; a sample tick discards the checked snapshot and restarts lookup/validation after audio. Rendering latency is unchanged.

Packet predecode registers 20 payload-signature equality slices plus opcode equality and ten payload-zero words. Identity and business checks are registered independently, then selected into the checked completion. Sample tick cancels all three validation stages; no command side effects occur before handshake.
constraints: Single 50 MHz clock domain; reset cancels in-flight work.
See ENGINE.md for exact fixed-point and command ABI.
